name: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
description: User input in the 'q' parameter is reflected into the response without encoding.
remediation: Context-aware output encoding and a strict CSP.

name: SQL Injection (error-based)
description: Error-based SQL injection in the 'id' parameter; database error strings returned.

name: IDOR / Broken Object-Level Authorization
description: Sequential order IDs are accessible across accounts without an authorization check (BOLA).

name: Server-Side Request Forgery (blind)
description: Blind SSRF confirmed via OAST/interactsh out-of-band DNS callback.
remediation: Allowlist outbound hosts; block link-local/metadata ranges.

name: Missing Security Headers
description: Content-Security-Policy and Strict-Transport-Security headers are absent.
remediation: Add CSP and HSTS response headers.

name: Verbose Server Banner
description: Server header discloses the exact web server and version.
remediation: Suppress version disclosure in the server banner.
